basics.description: **Note:** Please refer to the following before installing the solution: • Review the solution [Release Notes](https://github.com/Azure/Azure-Sentinel/tree/master/Solutions/Bindplane/ReleaseNotes.md) • There may be [known issues](https://aka.ms/sentinelsolutionsknownissues) pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing. Bindplane is a telemetry pipeline platform that collects, normalizes, and routes OpenTelemetry data. The Bindplane Microsoft Sentinel destination delivers normalized security telemetry directly into native Microsoft Sentinel ASIM tables. **Data Connectors:** 1, **Workbooks:** 1 [Learn more about Microsoft Sentinel](https://aka.ms/azuresentinel) | [Learn more about Solutions](https://aka.ms/azuresentinelsolutionsdoc)

options.text: This Solution installs the data connector for Bindplane. You can get Bindplane custom log data in your Microsoft Sentinel workspace. After installing the solution, configure and enable this data connector by following guidance in Manage solution view.

link.label: Learn more about connecting data sources

options.text: Verify Bindplane is delivering data into Microsoft Sentinel ASIM tables and inspect event volume by source.

Verify Bindplane is delivering normalized telemetry into Microsoft Sentinel ASIM tables. Surfaces event volume per ASIM table, distribution by upstream EventVendor / EventProduct, and last-data-received per table, all scoped to Bindplane-routed records via the AdditionalFields.Attribution.bindplane_source marker.
